notes.title: New ReSetna Patch - more combat improvements
notes.notes:
We keep fine-tuning ReSetna to make the gameplay better!
These changes are part of our ongoing effort to improve the experience based on your feedback.
Our Patch #7 improves combat feel, enemy behavior and overall balance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155099/e3a6e3022ecb3ae1fa3ea018d646de2844bcca29.jpg

Gameplay & Combat Adjustments


- New Enemy Dodge Animations – Certain enemies now have improved dodging animations

- Enemies Flash on Hit – Enemies now briefly flash when hit, giving clearer visual feedback during combat

This is how new enemy dodge animations and enemy damage VFX look like:

[previewyoutube=Aw8FQUinzeE;full][/previewyoutube]

Other Combat Adjustments

- Cutter Biped New Combo – The Cutter Biped enemy received a new attack combo

- Sola9 Looping Attack Bug Fixes – Fixed an issue where Sola9 could get stuck in an attack loop

- Cerpiant Attack Hit Collision Adjustments – Tweaked hit detection on Cerpiant’s attacks for improved accuracy and consistency

- General Boss Balancing – Adjustments to various boss encounters to improve difficulty scaling and combat flow

Player Improvements & Fixes

- Player Combo Skipping Issue Fixed – Resolved a bug where certain player attack combos would unintentionally skip sequences

- Player Attack Hitbox Adjustments – Fine-tuned hitboxes on player attacks to improve precision and responsiveness

- Player Charge Attack During Interaction Bug Fixed – Fixed an issue where charge attacks could trigger unexpectedly during interactive moments

Visual & UI Enhancements

- UI Scaling Option Added – Players can now adjust the UI scale

- Enemy VFX Optimization & Updates – Improved enemy visual effects for better performance

Boss & Quest Fixes

- Darkness Boss Quest & Behavior Fixes – Addressed various issues affecting the Darkness boss fight, ensuring smoother progression and more consistent behavior

This patch continues our effort to refine and enhance the ReSetna experience.
Let us know your thoughts!

If you need any help or tips&tricks, join our Discord Community:
https://discord.gg/r7paMbkVvD


ReSetna Team

notes.title: ReSetna major update - RUBY ARMOR UPGRADE
notes.notes:
After 12 updates in just a month, ReSetna is completely overhauled based on YOUR feedback.

We were in constant communication with our players to give you the game you deserve! Every single review and suggestion made it into our development backlog.

We are introducing the most powerful update of ReSetna yet - RUBY ARMOR UPGRADE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155099/52547a9ed47834586911a3832e213ffb886c17a7.jpg

The new armor isn’t just a visual upgrade, it is a synonym for more combat-ready ReSetna! Now, with reworked combat, improved controls and ReSetna upgraded systems, the fight against the Signal is more intense and thrilling than before.

[previewyoutube=jQxZDE-i1_4;full][/previewyoutube]

Let’s dive into the details!

Visual & Environment Upgrades:

- Resetna is now playable with a new "Ruby Armor" skin. This option can be toggled through the Character menu if  you wish to return to default skin
- Environment revamp with new visual effects and background elements, backed up with new, immersive sound effects
- The final boss fight is now conceptually better with a brand new cut scene before the start of the fight
- New UI effects that enhance the player's experience and reduce previous confusion

[previewyoutube=GsbgPf5H2RQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Combat upgrades:

- All weapons are now improved, more responsive and enjoyable: animations and combos have been re-made and optimized for player's experience
- Axe combo now has a faster, more responsive chain of attacks
- Sabre's attacks are now much more enjoyable and responsive with new animations along with its parry-counterattack and in-air attacks
- Naginata has also been reworked making the weapon feel more impactful, heavier, along with new parry-counterattack and in-air attacks
- Laser projectiles from most basic enemies are now reflectable - the player is now able to avoid annoying ranged attacks, reflect them and still do a strong parry-counterattack while doing that

[previewyoutube=rfz2qisOTWM;full][/previewyoutube]

Other changes:

- Key rebinding, a very much requested feature, is finally here. Players will now be able to customize their input keys, as well as choose from presets when playing on controllers
- Side quests now feel more useful, giving rewards and upgrades, making exploration worthwhile
Settings user experience has been improved by adding an "Apply changes" key to avoid setting application at each change
- "Developer's note" window has been added to notify our players of what changes we've made

How to get the Update

The RUBY ARMOR UPGRADE is a free, automatic download that will be available once you visit our game page on Steam.

You may need to restart your Steam client to initiate the download.
The complete Patch Notes are available in our official Discord, where you can join a community of other ReSetna players.

In case of any bugs, please send us details with screenshots, videos or player log file to developer@tgdevs.com and we will respond promptly - as always :)

Player log file is on your PC, and you can access it here:
AppData/LocalLow/Today's Games/ReSetna
Player.log file

Closing Notes

We hope you will enjoy these latest improvements!
As always, we’re listening to your feedback and working to refine ReSetna further.

If you have any feedback or suggestions for us, let us know on our Discord.
We are always there!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our journey!
--
Discord: https://discord.gg/r7paMbkVvD
X: @tgdevs_official

notes.title: ReSetna Dev Update
notes.notes:
We are listening & improving!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone playing ReSetna! We want you to know - we are listening.
Our team is constantly working on updates, polishing the experience and addressing your feedback. And by this, we mean especially bug reports and gameplay improvements.

At the moment, this is what we are working on

Gameplay Adjustments & Fixes
- Smoother movement – Removing light pushback in the air and ensuring you keep momentum
- Better aiming & combat controls – Right stick will activate aiming, Left Bumper will be for ranged attacks, and aiming will smoothly adjust the camera
- Combat feel & flow – Ground pound will cancel combos properly, and time scaling in combos will be adjusted for better responsiveness

UI & QoL Improvements
- Mini-map is coming! It’ll be on the bottom right, zoomed in for better navigation
- Ground pound cooldown – A visual indicator will make it clearer when you can use it again

Enemy & Boss Improvements
- Hitbox fixes – Large enemies will have proper hitboxes on both their bodies and legs
- Better pacing in battle zones – Enemy spawns will be adjusted for fairer, more strategic fights
- SOLA_9 boss arena adjustments – We’re refining platform placement for a smoother fight

Our goal is making sure you enjoy playing ReSetna

When we started designing ReSetna, our goal was to include everything one Metroidvania should have. This is why we included:
- double jumps
- air dashes
- wall jumps
- teleporting between checkpoints
- spawn points right in front of boss rooms
- ability to place markers on the map

We want ReSetna to be the game a true Metroidvania player loves to play.
That is why we are listening and trying to make ReSetna better every day. Keep the feedback coming!
If there is any support you need, feel free to contact us on developer@tgdevs.com


ReSetna Dev Team

notes.title: Developer Update #5 – DEMO with new features on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Greetings, OptiGens!

We're excited to share that ReSetna is LIVE as part of Steam Next Fest from Oct 14-21! But that's not all—we’re also being featured in INDIE Live Expo's Let's Play! Steam NEXT Fest showcase on October 16! 🎮✨

If you haven’t played the demo yet, now’s the perfect time to jump in and explore our sci-fi dystopian world as we’ve implemented new updates based on your feedback:


New Features & Improvements:

⚙️ Enemy Parry Logic:
Added a new VFX effect to indicate when enemies are preparing to parry your attacks. Timing your moves is now more intuitive.

⚔️ Axe Attack Combo Animations:
Updated the animation for axe attack combos, now with a stronger build-up for each hit, making your strikes feel more impactful.

🎛️ In-Game Options:
You can now access new Options directly in the game menu, giving you more control over your gameplay experience.

Gameplay Adjustments:

🚁 Parried Drone Enemies:
Drone enemies that are successfully parried will now be pushed away, creating space for follow-up attacks or defensive maneuvers.

🎯 Improved Enemy Attack Anticipation:
We've made adjustments to enemy attack animations, making it easier to notice the parry window.

We can’t wait for your feedback on these changes! Try out the ReSetna demo during Steam Next Fest and let us know what you think right here in the Steam Community Hub or our official Discord server.

ReSetna development continues at full speed! Check out the latest updates!
Here’s what we’ve been working on:

New Enemy Combos & Bio Link System
We've been implementing fresh enemy combos and refining the bio link system. While there are still minor issues (such as enemies jumping to the wrong platforms due to pathfinding bugs), the system is mostly functional, and progress is looking good. We've also polished combat mechanics for enemies.

Animation & Boss Mechanics
We’re focusing on animating biped enemies and polishing existing animation sets. The [REDACTED] chunk designs are nearly done, and we're working closely to fine-tune the boss symbiote fight mechanics. At the same time, high-poly sculpts and textures for the [REDACTED] region are being finalized, as we prepare for further work in the next area. 

Player Controls & Combat Flow
We’re refining animation canceling for attacks, giving players the ability to interrupt mid-attack with jumps, dashes, or parries. Soon, we'll tackle fast-falling mechanics and directional charge attacks to add even more fluidity and depth to combat.

Level Design & Tutorial
The team is focused on polishing the tutorial section and fixing issues related to the save system, as well as refining the wound and death states for the player. We're also making progress on level, ensuring smooth transitions and improved layouts for a more polished experience.

We’re making great progress on all fronts, from gameplay mechanics to level design, ensuring ReSetna evolves into an immersive experience you won’t forget.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Developer Update #1: Demo Progress
notes.notes:
🚧 Developer Update #1: Demo Progress 🚧 

Greetings OptiGen Subjects!

To keep you in the (circuit) loop, we've decided to share regular updates on our progress as we continue developing ReSetna. 

We’re currently in the final stages of polishing the demo for release in October. This demo will feature the game’s first zone—Polis13. In this area, players will get a first look at the state of the world, familiarize themselves with the controls, encounter various enemies and NPCs, and even have the chance to face off against the first boss.

Polis13 is also where the main questline begins, gradually drawing players into the story and setting the stage for the epic journey ahead.

Here’s what we’re focusing on right now:

• Polishing enemy behaviors and improving overall pacing to ensure a smooth and challenging gameplay experience.
• Adding new models and animations to enhance the visual and immersive quality of the game.

We’re excited for you to explore Polis13 and can’t wait to hear your thoughts once the demo is live!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support!
